description: Canal de la Neste is a dataset listed in Gers-OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SAGE NRG. Tracé du canal de la Neste La Commission Locale de l’Eau Neste & Rivières de Gascogne, en charge de l’élaboration du Schéma d’Aménagement et de Gestion des Eaux, met à disposition à l’ensemble du public l’ensemble des fichiers cartographiques ouverts issus de l’état initial-diagnostic du territoire du SAGE NRG. Coverage: Gers. The portal files it under Développement durable. Its keywords are Hydrographie, Canal, SAGE. The portal shows 1 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-01-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gers-fr-portal.
